title: Ground and Whole
subject: food
author: Clueberry Desk
introduction: Ten jars from the back of the cupboard, most of them older than the recipes that use them.

entries.clue: Green pods crushed into Gulf coffee
Rhizome that stains the chopping board yellow
Threads pulled by hand from a crocus
Ground sweet pepper on a Hungarian shelf
Orchid pod, and a byword for plain
Grated over custard, and a trick played through the legs
Root grated into tea for a sore throat
Seed doing most of the work in a taco
Dried flower bud stuck into a ham
Tart red powder scattered over fattoush

factCards.text: Saffron is the dried stigmas of Crocus sativus and is harvested by hand, which is the main reason for its price.
Vanilla comes from the cured seed pods of orchids in the genus Vanilla; hand pollination, developed in the 1840s, made cultivation outside Mexico possible.
factCards.sourceTitle: Kew Royal Botanic Gardens — Vanilla planifolia plant profile

factCards.text: Nutmeg and mace come from the same tree, Myristica fragrans: the seed and the red aril wrapped around it.
factCards.sourceTitle: Kew Royal Botanic Gardens — Myristica fragrans plant profile
